units.rawText: Professor, Professor! Is there anything I can do to help?

units.rawText: ...Looking back, when I first found you, Jiangyu, your... "style" was quite different from other Dolls.
units.displayText: ...Looking back, when I first found you, Jiangyu, your... "style" was quite different from other Dolls.

spans.text: ...Looking back, when I first found you, Jiangyu, your... "style" was quite different from other Dolls.

units.rawText: Eh? What do you mean? Is that a compliment?

spans.text: Eh? What do you mean? Is that a compliment?

units.rawText: Hmm... Not exactly... Most Dolls when being chased by Entropics would all run for their lives; but you on the other hand, were chasing down Low Order Entropics with your weapons at the ready.
units.displayText: Hmm... Not exactly... Most Dolls when being chased by Entropics would all run for their lives; but you on the other hand, were chasing down Low Order Entropics with your weapons at the ready.

units.rawText: Ahahaha! I, uh, I saw those Entropics bully our traders, so I got all heated and couldn't resist helping... I only knew how dangerous those things were afterwards.

units.rawText: Urk... And I remember how much I troubled you when I first arrived at the Oasis, especially with the movie you helped me film! I'll treasure that movie forever!

units.rawText: It only came at the minor price of three printers, two coffee machines, and all kinds of props...

units.rawText: But this place has become more lively than ever since Jiangyu joined the Oasis. I'm counting on you to keep the energy up around here!
